footnotes: From pre-tax income to net loss to TDS: includes a $62.2M income tax benefit; after $131M of discontinued operations, $26.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $69.2M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 5.3% to $1.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 59.0%, versus 54.5% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $97.4M from $191M.
The net loss narrowed to $75.5M, or −$0.65 per share, from $96.9M. Operating cash flow was $590M and free cash flow $199M, versus $780M; TDS returned $108M through buybacks.
sources: Telephone and Data Systems, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
